k-sym-SOYOUARE.title: Justice For So You Are (Melbourne Cup horse) coins
k-sym-SOYOUARE.sourceSays: Posts say a Melbourne Cup horse, So You Are, was found dead in a Sydney skip bin and the news went viral today, citing CNN and Sky Sports; another post reacts to it. Unverified here.
k-sym-SOYOUARE.reason: Two posts of Nov 17 (12:03-12:04 UTC) discuss the reported horse death as a news event; the rest are call-group shills. Pools opened under an hour ago, after the story, so launched on it.
